c74object.name: gst.classification.gmm
c74object.digest: Gaussian Mixture Models for real-time recognition of incoming data [list]
c74object.description:
gst.classification.gmm is real-time state recognition of incoming data [list of floats]. It is based on Gaussian Mixture Models and
uses mubu.gmm of MuBu package from ISMM team
at IRCAM Centre Pompidou http://ismm.ircam.fr/pipo/

inlet.description: Label is a sample of incoming data to be trained by the algorithm.
number of samples of incoming data to be trained by the algorithm for state recognition.

Regularization (relative = absolute here) allows to artificially increase the generalization of the model.
It is an offset Added to the diagonal of covariance matrices for convergence.
A large offset improves the generalization of the model, but can reduce the accuracy of the recognition.
The relative value is proportional to the variance of the training data. The Absolute value is the minimum offset.
messages for internal mubu.gmm object configuration.
messages for internal imubu object configuration.

outlet.description: size depends on the total number of labels.

Regularization (relative = absolute here) allows to artificially increase the generalization of the model.
